title: Villa Mavi — Panoramic Bay View Villa in Taşyaka, Fethiye
headline: A four-bedroom architect-built villa above Fethiye marina, with an infinity pool aimed straight at the bay.
highlights: Uninterrupted views over Fethiye bay and the Twelve Islands
Ten minutes on foot to the marina promenade and Tuesday market
Completed 2021 with individual title deed already issued
description: Villa Mavi occupies one of the last elevated plots in Taşyaka, the residential shoulder of Fethiye town where the hillside turns to face the bay. The house is arranged over three levels so that every principal room — including all four bedrooms — takes the view rather than sharing it.

The ground floor opens completely onto the pool terrace through full-height sliding glazing, so the living space and the 10-metre infinity pool read as a single room in summer. A separate winter lounge with a wood burner and underfloor heating makes the villa genuinely usable between November and March, which matters more than most buyers expect.

Because the property is walkable to Fethiye centre, it performs as both a lock-up-and-leave second home and a strong year-round rental asset. The individual title deed is issued and clean, and the purchase price sits comfortably above the current Turkish citizenship-by-investment threshold.

title: Villa Lagün — Blue Lagoon View Villa in Ölüdeniz
headline: A three-bedroom stone-and-glass villa on the Ölüdeniz hillside, looking down onto the Blue Lagoon.
highlights: Uninterrupted sightline to the Blue Lagoon and Babadağ paragliding descent
Proven short-let history with repeat British guests
Sold furnished and turnkey — rentable from completion
description: Villa Lagün sits on the quiet upper road out of Ölüdeniz, high enough that the Blue Lagoon opens up below the terrace and low enough to still walk down to the beach road. The stone facade and deep roof overhangs keep the interior cool through August without leaning on air conditioning.

Inside, the layout is deliberately simple: a double-height living space on the entrance level, three double bedrooms — two with en-suite access — and a covered outdoor kitchen that ends up hosting most of the summer. The 8-metre pool is positioned to catch afternoon sun until it drops behind Babadağ.

The villa is being sold furnished with an existing short-let booking history, which makes it one of the few properties in our Ölüdeniz portfolio that can produce income in its first season without any further outlay.

title: Villa Zeytin — Hillside Villa in Hisarönü
headline: A three-bedroom villa above Hisarönü with a private pool and the whole valley in front of it.
highlights: Ten minutes on foot to the Hisarönü strip, far enough up the hill to stay quiet
Strong July–September occupancy with British repeat guests
Below the citizenship threshold — a straightforward lifestyle purchase
description: Villa Zeytin sits on the terraced slope above Hisarönü, where the valley opens out towards Babadağ. The house is arranged over two floors with the living space, kitchen and a guest WC at garden level, and three double bedrooms above.

The plot is 420 m² with a seven-metre pool, mature olive trees and a covered parking bay. Everything is on one title deed, mortgage-free, and the vendor is a British owner who has held the property since new.
Hisarönü is the most rental-driven address we cover: the resort centre is a ten-minute walk downhill and Ölüdeniz beach is a short dolmuş ride away.

title: Villa Deniz — Beachside Villa in Çalış
headline: A four-bedroom family villa a level ten-minute walk from Çalış beach and its sunset promenade.
highlights: Flat, level walk to the beach — no hill, which matters more than buyers expect
Four genuine doubles: the plan works for two families sharing
Built 2021 to current earthquake regulations, with DASK in place
description: Villa Deniz was completed in 2021 on one of the quieter residential streets behind Çalış beach. The ground floor is open-plan with a separate utility room; upstairs there are four double bedrooms, two of them en-suite.
The garden is level and low-maintenance, with a nine-metre pool, a pergola and a built-in outdoor kitchen. Parking for two cars sits behind an automatic gate.
Çalış suits owners who want to walk everywhere: the promenade, the water taxi into Fethiye and the Sunday market are all within reach on foot.

title: Villa Marina — Marina View Villa in Göcek
headline: A five-bedroom architect-built villa above Göcek marina, in the most defensive resale market we cover.
highlights: Göcek holds value better than anywhere else on this coast — six marinas and strict low-density planning
Architect-built in 2022 with a lift, which is rare in the local market
Comfortably above the citizenship investment threshold
description: Villa Marina occupies a 900 m² plot on the hillside above Göcek, arranged over three floors with a lift connecting all of them. Every bedroom is en-suite, and the principal suite takes the whole top floor.
The living space opens onto a twelve-metre infinity-edge pool with the marina and the gulf beyond it. A separate lower floor holds the second kitchen, utility space and a double garage.
Göcek is the yachting capital of the Gulf of Fethiye. Low-density planning rules, six marinas and a short transfer from Dalaman airport keep this the most defensive resale market on the coast.

title: Marina Residence — Sea View Apartment in Fethiye
headline: A two-bedroom apartment on the Fethiye marina promenade, with a balcony over the bay.
features: Walk to the marina and Tuesday market
highlights: On the promenade: everything in Fethiye town is walkable from the front door
Lift and allocated parking — both scarce in central Fethiye
The lowest entry point in our portfolio, and the easiest to let year-round
description: Marina Residence is a 2018 block on the Fethiye promenade, a few minutes from the marina and the Tuesday market. This third-floor apartment has two double bedrooms, a bathroom and an open-plan living space opening onto a sea-view balcony.
The building has a lift, secure entry, a communal pool and an allocated parking space. Monthly service charges (aidat) are low for the area and cover the pool, gardens and cleaning.
Central Fethiye works year-round rather than only in summer: a working town with full-time amenities, which makes this the easiest property in our portfolio to let outside the peak season.
